description: Hardware inventory and health of a server fleet from node_exporter metrics: platform, CPU, memory and DIMMs, storage, network, thermals, power, OS and firmware, a per-host passport, and health signals that usually have no alerts. Physical hosts by default; switch Kind for VMs.

panels.description: Hosts in scope, counted by node_dmi_info rather than up, so every exporter target with DMI data is included whatever its job name.

targets.expr: count(group by (instance) (node_dmi_info{$kind, system_vendor=~"$vendor", product_name=~"$model", env=~"$env", project=~"$project", role=~"$role", region=~"$region", dc=~"$dc", instance=~"($host).*"}))

panels.title: Hosts

panels.description: Distinct system_vendor values in DMI. An empty vendor (ASRockRack leaves it blank) counts as one.

targets.expr: count(group by (system_vendor) (node_dmi_info{$kind, system_vendor=~"$vendor", product_name=~"$model", env=~"$env", project=~"$project", role=~"$role", region=~"$region", dc=~"$dc", instance=~"($host).*"}))

panels.title: Vendors

panels.description: Distinct vendor × model combinations.

targets.expr: count(group by (system_vendor, product_name) (node_dmi_info{$kind, system_vendor=~"$vendor", product_name=~"$model", env=~"$env", project=~"$project", role=~"$role", region=~"$region", dc=~"$dc", instance=~"($host).*"}))

panels.title: Platforms

targets.expr: count(group by (model_name) (((node_cpu_info{model_name=~"$cpu"}) and on(instance) group by (instance) (node_dmi_info{$kind, system_vendor=~"$vendor", product_name=~"$model", env=~"$env", project=~"$project", role=~"$role", region=~"$region", dc=~"$dc", instance=~"($host).*"}))))

panels.description: Physical cores and hardware threads summed over the scope.

targets.expr: count(group by (instance, package, core) (((node_cpu_info{model_name=~"$cpu"}) and on(instance) group by (instance) (node_dmi_info{$kind, system_vendor=~"$vendor", product_name=~"$model", env=~"$env", project=~"$project", role=~"$role", region=~"$region", dc=~"$dc", instance=~"($host).*"}))))

count(group by (instance, cpu) (((node_cpu_info{model_name=~"$cpu"}) and on(instance) group by (instance) (node_dmi_info{$kind, system_vendor=~"$vendor", product_name=~"$model", env=~"$env", project=~"$project", role=~"$role", region=~"$region", dc=~"$dc", instance=~"($host).*"}))))

panels.title: Cores / Threads

panels.description: Sum of MemTotal. This is the memory visible to the kernel, 1–2 % less than installed.

targets.expr: sum(((node_memory_MemTotal_bytes) and on(instance) group by (instance) (node_dmi_info{$kind, system_vendor=~"$vendor", product_name=~"$model", env=~"$env", project=~"$project", role=~"$role", region=~"$region", dc=~"$dc", instance=~"($host).*"})))

panels.title: RAM

targets.expr: count(((node_nvme_info{state="live"}) and on(instance) group by (instance) (node_dmi_info{$kind, system_vendor=~"$vendor", product_name=~"$model", env=~"$env", project=~"$project", role=~"$role", region=~"$region", dc=~"$dc", instance=~"($host).*"})))
count(group by (dc) (node_dmi_info{$kind, system_vendor=~"$vendor", product_name=~"$model", env=~"$env", project=~"$project", role=~"$role", region=~"$region", dc=~"$dc", instance=~"($host).*"}))

panels.description: Hosts with corrected memory errors since the last reboot. Non-zero means a module is degrading.

targets.expr: count(max by (instance) (((node_edac_correctable_errors_total) and on(instance) group by (instance) (node_dmi_info{$kind, system_vendor=~"$vendor", product_name=~"$model", env=~"$env", project=~"$project", role=~"$role", region=~"$region", dc=~"$dc", instance=~"($host).*"}))) > 0) or on() vector(0)

panels.title: EDAC CE

panels.title: EDAC UE

targets.expr: count(max by (instance) (((nvme_monitor_critical_warnings) and on(instance) group by (instance) (node_dmi_info{$kind, system_vendor=~"$vendor", product_name=~"$model", env=~"$env", project=~"$project", role=~"$role", region=~"$region", dc=~"$dc", instance=~"($host).*"}))) > 0) or on() vector(0)

panels.title: NVMe warn

panels.title: RAID degraded

panels.description: Hosts whose fastest core runs below 60 % of the allowed maximum: PROCHOT or a BIOS power cap.

targets.expr: count((max by (instance) (((node_cpu_scaling_frequency_hertz) and on(instance) group by (instance) (node_dmi_info{$kind, system_vendor=~"$vendor", product_name=~"$model", env=~"$env", project=~"$project", role=~"$role", region=~"$region", dc=~"$dc", instance=~"($host).*"}))) / clamp_min(max by (instance) (((node_cpu_scaling_frequency_max_hertz) and on(instance) group by (instance) (node_dmi_info{$kind, system_vendor=~"$vendor", product_name=~"$model", env=~"$env", project=~"$project", role=~"$role", region=~"$region", dc=~"$dc", instance=~"($host).*"}))), 1)) < 0.6) or on() vector(0)

panels.title: Host passport

options.content:
**Kind.** `physical` = everything that is not a VM by `bios_vendor` (Hetzner Cloud, SeaBIOS / QEMU, OVMF, EC2, GCE, Azure / Hyper-V, VMware, VirtualBox, DigitalOcean, Vultr, Xen). Bare-metal servers with an empty `product_name` still count as physical.

**Scope.** Every panel is filtered through `node_dmi_info` and the inventory labels, so «Hosts» may differ from a count of `up`. The **CPU** variable filters only the CPU row and the CPU columns of the passport: hosts without `node_cpu_info` must not disappear from the inventory.

**Labels.** Env / Project / Role / Region / DC read the target labels `env`, `project`, `role`, `region`, `dc`. Hosts without them still show up under All.

**Empty cells.** An empty cell in a table means the metric is missing on that host, not «all good».

**Health.** Signals that usually have no alerts. Cell values: counter (EDAC), percent (spare), ratio (frequency), degrees, number of channels / part numbers.

**Optional sources.** DIMM inventory (`dimm_*`), IPMI power and PSU state (`ipmi_*`), CPU tuning (`cpu_tuning_*`) and NVMe SMART (`nvme_monitor_*`) come from extra textfile collectors; RAPL needs read access to `energy_uj`. Panels without their source stay empty. See the README for the metric contract.

**RAPL** (CPU energy, row 8 · POWER) is CPU package power, not wall draw.
